description: This is a Java unit test class for DefaultClientActorPropsFactory, testing serialization of actor properties for different connection types (AMQP, MQTT, Kafka) used in messaging client actor creation within the Eclipse Ditto framework.

classes.name: DefaultClientActorPropsFactoryTest
classes.description: A JUnit test case for testing serialization of actor properties for messaging client actors with various connection types.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the ActorSystem, Serialization extension, and the factory under test before each test.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Shuts down the ActorSystem after each test.

methods.name: amqp091ActorPropsIsSerializable
methods.description: Tests serialization integrity for AMQP_091 connection type actor props.

methods.name: amqp10ActorPropsIsSerializable
methods.description: Tests serialization integrity for AMQP_10 connection type actor props.

methods.name: mqttActorPropsIsSerializable
methods.description: Tests serialization of MQTT connection actor props.

methods.name: mqtt5ActorPropsIsSerializable
methods.description: Checks serialization consistency for MQTT 5 connection actor props.

methods.name: kafkaActorPropsIsSerializable
methods.description: Checks serialization of Kafka connection actor props.

methods.name: actorPropsIsSerializable
methods.description: Helper method to test serialization of Props for a given connection type.

methods.name: actorPropsIsSerializableAndEqualDeserializedObject
methods.description: Helper method to verify that Props can be serialized and deserialized back to an equivalent object.

methods.name: serializeAndDeserialize
methods.description: Performs serialization and deserialization cycles on a given object, returning the deserialized object.

methods.name: wrapForSerialization
methods.description: Wraps a Props object into a DaemonMsgCreate for correct Akka serialization.

methods.name: randomConnection
methods.description: Generates a random Connection object with a specified connection type for testing.
